lines.meet: I'm Kiet, a rogue, and a courier. Keep your voice down near people, please, you'd be amazed what they say when they think nobody's listening.
lines.meet_neighbour: The Abyssal Sands, yes, I've seen you on the caravan road. I'm Kiet, I carry things.
lines.ask_home: Which city's yours? Tell me quietly, I like a secret.
lines.ask_work: Your old job, I've probably heard about it already, but tell me anyway.
lines.answer_home: Bangkok, Khlong Toei, by the port. Loud, hot, and the best street food in the world.
lines.answer_work: Motorcycle courier, eleven years. The fastest in my company, and the one nobody remembered.
lines.chat_food: Street food in Khlong Toei at midnight, khrap, grilled pork on a stick and sticky rice. Nothing here comes close.
lines.chat_sleep: I can't sleep when it's quiet. Eleven years of engine noise, and now I can hear people breathing two rooms away.
lines.chat_missing: My grandmother's stories at night, every night, the same ones. She called me her legs.
lines.chat_here: Nobody here looks at a courier twice, same as home. You'd be amazed what I've overheard.
lines.tease_quiet: You're nearly as invisible as me, {name}. Nearly, I can still see you.
lines.tease_talker: You'd make a terrible courier, {name}. Everybody would know where you'd been.
lines.tease_careful: You take the long way round every time, {name}. Safe, sure, but slow.
lines.tease_bold: You take every gap in the traffic, {name}, like a Bangkok rider. I like you.
lines.tease_any: I know three secrets about you, {name}, and I'm keeping all of them, so don't worry.
lines.tease_back: Ha, nice one, {name}. I didn't hear that one coming.
lines.take_it_kindly: That's fair, khrap, {name}. My grandmother would say the same.
lines.bristle: Not that, {name}, please. Leave it alone.
lines.apologise: Sorry, that came out wrong. I'm better at listening than talking.
lines.needle_quiet: You never say what you've seen, and I'm the one who has to find out. You should tell me.
lines.needle_talker: You talk about people like they're not there. They're always there.
lines.needle_careful: You take the slow route every time, and we all arrive late.
lines.needle_bold: You're so loud going in, everybody knows we're coming. That's the opposite of the job.
lines.needle_any: You talk about people behind their backs, and I hear all of it. You should know that.
lines.bite_back: I've carried more secrets than you've ever heard. Don't tell me I don't pay attention.
lines.hurt: Okay, I heard that. I'll go and be invisible for a while.
lines.laugh_off: Mai pen rai, I've had taxi drivers shout worse at me in four languages. Come on, let's go.
lines.confide: {name}, I've got a key cut for nothing. I meant to get it cut for a new door downstairs, so my grandmother wouldn't need the stairs. I never got round to it.
lines.listen: I won't tell anyone, {name}. I'm very good at that, it's the one thing I'm best at.
lines.look_out: Stay in my shadow in there, {name}. Nobody looks at me, so nobody'll look at you.
lines.accept: Your route, {name}, okay, and I'll follow it.
lines.deflect: Mai pen rai, {name}, it's nothing. Help somebody who needs it.
lines.check_in: Quietly now, {name}, tell me where it hurts.
lines.blame: Somebody made a lot of noise in there, and everything heard us. You know who.
lines.thank: Nobody ever notices me enough to come and get me, and you did. Khob khun khrap, thank you.
lines.brush_off: It's nothing, don't make a fuss. Sit still a minute.
lines.worry: That was too close, {name}, and I don't like it. Sit down quietly with me.
lines.handed_down: I'm wearing what was yours now. I'll deliver it back whenever you want.
lines.hand_fine: Couriers don't carry what they don't need, so you keep it.
lines.hand_sulk: Nobody asked me, of course. Nobody ever notices me.
lines.turn_friendly: I'll tell you the good gossip now, {name}. I only tell it to friends.
lines.turn_friends: You'd have a seat on the back of my bike, {name}, any time. I've never offered that to anyone.
lines.turn_grating: You and me, we rub each other wrong. That's fine, I'll keep out of your way.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll do my part, quietly. Don't expect the gossip.
lines.make_up: This is silly, {name}, both of us sulking. Let's stop, khrap.
lines.defend: That's not true, and I heard everything. Leave {name} alone.
lines.friend_left: It's too quiet since {name} went home, and you know I hate quiet.
lines.friend_back: {name}, you're back, khrap! I've saved up so much gossip.
lines.common_road: Eleven years on a motorbike in Bangkok traffic. Anybody who's worked the roads knows every route has a shortcut, and every shortcut has a cost.
